tools.name: brighthr_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of your BrightHR organisation with name, job title, start and end dates, email, external reference and registration/termination status. Filter by email, external reference or termination status. Paginated: pass the returned continuationToken to get the next page. BrightHR Customer

tools.name: brighthr_set_employee_external_reference
tools.description: WRITE: set or clear the external reference of one employee (1-36 characters; several employees may share one). Use it to link a BrightHR employee to an id in another system. Replaces any existing value. Pass null to clear it. BrightHR Customer API: PUT /employees/v1/{employeeId}/external-reference.

tools.name: brighthr_list_clockings
tools.description: List Blip clock-in records of one employee: clock-in and clock-out times with time zones, breaks and notes, within an optional date range. Paginated with continuationToken. BrightHR Customer API: POST /blip/v1/clockings/query.

tools.name: brighthr_list_absences
tools.description: List approved absences of one employee within an optional date range: holiday, sickness, time off in lieu (TOIL) and other. Lateness is not included. Each item has a $type field. Paginated with continuationToken. BrightHR Customer API: POST /absences/v1/query.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brighthr_list_employees, brighthr_list_clockings, brighthr_list_absences · Private data: brighthr_list_clockings · Public sink: brighthr_list_employees, brighthr_set_employee_external_reference, brighthr_list_clockings, brighthr_list_absences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: brighthr_list_employees, brighthr_list_clockings, brighthr_list_absences · Private data: brighthr_list_clockings · Public sink: brighthr_list_employees, brighthr_set_employee_external_reference, brighthr_list_clockings, brighthr_list_absences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
